title: LAW Nº 018/2026 OF 23/04/2026 AMENDING LAW N° 29/2017 OF 29/06/2017 ESTABLISHING THE LONGTERM SAVINGS SCHEME AND DETERMINING ITS ORGANISATION

articles.heading: Conditions for the provision of benefits to a member
Entry into force 10 LAW Nº 018/2026 OF 23/04/2026 AMENDING LAW Nº 29/2017 OF
articles.text:
29/06/2017 ESTABLISHING THE LONGTERM SAVINGS SCHEME AND
DETERMINING ITS ORGANISATION
We, KAGAME Paul,
President of the Republic;
THE PARLIAMENT HAS ADOPTED
AND WE SANCTION, PROMULGATE
THE FOLLOWING LAW AND ORDER
IT BE PUBLISHED IN THE OFFICIAL
GAZETTE OF THE REPUBLIC OF
RWANDA
THE PARLIAMENT:
The Chamber of Deputies, in its sitting of 02
April 2026;
Pursuant to the Constitution of the Republic of
Rwanda, especially in Article 64;
Having reviewed Law n° 29/2017 of
29/06/2017 establishing the long-term savings
scheme and determining its organisation, in

articles.heading: of Law n° 29/2017 of 29/06/2017 establishing the long-term savings scheme and determining its organisation is amended as
articles.text:
follows: “
(1) Benefits due to a member are provided
upon the occurrence of any of the
following conditions:
(a) the member has attained the age of
at least 55 years;
(b) the death of the member;
(c) the member is affected by a
disability or illness resulting in his
or her inability to continue to pay
his or her savings contributions;
(d) the member, being a foreign
national, has ceased to be
permanently resident in Rwanda;
(e) the member opts to use a portion of
his or her savings.
12
(2) However, a member who has attained the
age of at least 55 years or a member who is
a foreign national and who has ceased to be
permanently resident in Rwanda, may opt
to maintain his or her savings in the longterm savings scheme.
(3) An Order of the Minister in charge of
finance determines the procedures for the
provision of benefits to a member.”

articles.heading: Conditions d’octroi des prestations à un membre L’article 9 de la Loi n° 29/2017 du 29/06/2017 portant création du régime
articles.text:
d’épargne à long terme et déterminant son
organisation est modifié comme suit: «
(1) Les prestations dues à un membre sont
octroyées en cas de survenance de l’une
des conditions suivantes:
(a) le membre a atteint l’âge d’au
moins 55 ans;
(b) le décès du membre;
(c) le membre est atteint d’une
invalidité ou d’une maladie
entraînant son incapacité à
continuer à verser ses cotisations
d’épargne;
(d) le membre, étant de nationalité
étrangère, a cessé d’avoir sa
résidence permanente au Rwanda;
(e) le membre opte pour l’utilisation
d’une partie de son épargne.
(2) Toutefois, un membre ayant atteint l’âge
d’au moins 55 ans ou un membre de
nationalité étrangère ayant cessé d’avoir
sa résidence permanente au Rwanda peut
opter pour le maintien de son épargne
dans le régime d’épargne à long terme.
(3) Un arrêté du Ministre ayant les finances
dans ses attributions détermine les
modalités d’octroi des prestations à un
membre. »

articles.heading: Impamvu zishingirwaho mu gutanga ibigenerwa umunyamuryango
Gutangira gukurikizwa ITEGEKO Nº 018/2026 RYO KU WA 23/04/2026 RIHINDURA ITEGEKO Nº 29/2017 RYO KU WA 29/06/2017
articles.text:
RISHYIRAHO UBWIZIGAME BW’IGIHE
KIREKIRE RIKANAGENA
IMITUNGANYIRIZE YABWO
Twebwe, KAGAME Paul,
Perezida wa Repubulika;
INTEKO ISHINGA AMATEGEKO
YEMEJE NONE NATWE DUHAMIJE,
DUTANGAJE ITEGEKO RITEYE RITYA
KANDI DUTEGETSE KO RITANGAZWA
MU IGAZETI YA LETA YA REPUBULIKA
Y’U RWANDA
INTEKO ISHINGA AMATEGEKO:
Umutwe w’Abadepite, mu nama yawo yo ku wa
02 Mata 2026;
Ishingiye ku Itegeko Nshinga rya Repubulika
y’u Rwanda, cyane cyane mu ngingo yaryo ya
64;
Isubiye ku Itegeko n° 29/2017 ryo ku wa
29/06/2017 rishyiraho ubwizigame bw’igihe
kirekire rikanagena imitunganyirize yabwo, mu
ngingo yaryo ya 9;
YEMEJE:

articles.heading: y’Itegeko n° 29/2017 ryo ku wa 29/06/2017 rishyiraho ubwizigame bw’igihe kirekire rikanagena imitunganyirize yabwo
articles.text:
ihinduwe ku buryo bukurikira: «
(1) Ibigenerwa umunyamuryango bitangwa iyo
habayeho imwe mu mpamvu zikurikira:
(a) agize nibura imyaka 55 y’amavuko;
(b) apfuye;
(c) agize ubumuga cyangwa uburwayi
butuma adakomeza gutanga
ubwizigame;
(d) ari umunyamahanga utagituye mu
Rwanda ku buryo buhoraho;
(e) yihitiyemo gukoresha igice
cy’ubwizigame bwe.
(2) Icyakora, umunyamuryango ugize nibura
imyaka 55 y’amavuko cyangwa
umunyamuryango w’umunyamahanga
utagituye mu Rwanda ku buryo buhoraho
ashobora kugumisha ubwizigame bwe mu
bwizigame bw’igihe kirekire.
(3) Iteka rya Minisitiri ufite imari mu nshingano
rigena uburyo bwo gutanga ibigenerwa
umunyamuryango.»
